payload.entry: Baseline: bob-cli-al reproduced from description + harness file:explicit:dd078a92f55551184b77dfc7 (authored=new commits |old). Generation guard existed in fetch handler but submit committed any typed row and the completion handler overwrote rows without any label check. Fix (bob-mac-capture, thin-client safe): prompt state gains suggestionAuthoredLabel; every label edit/cycle untags rows; submit commits only a fresh typed/match row else bob-grammar authored replacement (|label / |"multi word", mirroring collapse+quoted_form); probe responses gated on generation+draft+authoredLabel via testable applyRelationLabelSuggestions; completion handler adopts only query-matching rows and never clobbers fresh rows; Inserts/canSubmit gated on freshness. Tests: 9 new in CaptureRelationPanelTests (pending/immediate-Return, fresh-quoted, edit-invalidation, stale-gen drop, label-mismatch drop, spelling units, delayed+out-of-order async with fake-bob) + 2 probe fixtures/branches. Validation: mac just typecheck-tests exit 0; Linux swift build + swift test 1554 pass; fake-bob branches exercised; helper logic executed (6/6 incl. bob parity). XCTest execution itself not run here (mac has no XCTest, Linux has no AppKit) — left for CI/lander. Task bead bob-cli-al left OPEN for the lander.

Verified: mac just typecheck-tests exit 0 on the patched tree; Linux swift build --build-tests + swift test 1554/1554 pass; new fake-bob probe branches return typed-old/typed-new relation_label JSON; authored-replacement helper executed 6/6 incl. parity with bob normalize_relation_label; 9 new race regressions added (sync submit/gate/spelling + delayed/out-of-order async). XCTest execution itself not possible here (no XCTest on mac CLT, no AppKit on Linux) — CI/lander to run. Task bob-cli-al left open for the lander; no epic-symbol leftovers.

Fixed the frozen-clock glyph tests and reverse-conversion BLOCKS mirror. Focused bob-plugins suites pass (19/19 and 10/10); monitored npm test exited 0. Synced bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.56.1 and confirmed all 7 plugins synced with zero drift. Appended full baseline, fix, validation, sync, and remaining-constraint evidence to bob-cli-6v and bob-cli-7i. epic-symbols reported no leftovers.

LAND AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (2026-10-24): Read epic plan and all notes on .1, .2, .3, .4; there are ZERO PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries. Reviewed actual commits and source: bob-cli 30f10f15/0afeb2f3, bob-mac-capture 22598dc/8400bd3, bob-plugins e6b2ec2. Fetched every origin/master: no non-epic commit since this epic began, so no unrelated drift requires integration. b5, 6v, 7i independently verified and closed with evidence. Plugin focused suites pass 29/29; full-suite monitor yac9rg630jn6 passed 3529/3529 and phase sync record confirms all 7 plugins, navigation-hotkeys 2.56.1, zero drift. bob-cli CI 40084439229 fully green at 30f10f15; 40085996699 lint/package/Ubuntu pass at 0afeb2f3. Mac 40084777082 runs 2931 tests with only three b7 failures; relation race tests execute and pass, resolving the phase's XCTest availability caveat.

EPIC-CAUSED REMAINDER, keep 8a/al and this epic open: (1) Current capture_flag_guard.rs only understands pure switch clusters or a value-taking first short flag. Compiling this exact source module in a rustc harness confirms -nf json --bogus -- hi returns no GuardHit while -f json --bogus is rejected. The initial executable reproduction used stale target/debug/bob and is NOT current-tree integration evidence; the coder must build via Cargo's actual target_directory and reproduce safely. (2) 22598dc adds Swift relationLabelAuthoredReplacement, violating decisions:mac-capture-is-a-thin-client. Exact production submit+helper extracted into a Swift harness inserts |"see (old)" both while suggestions are pending AND with a fresh typed disabled candidate whose replacement is empty; the nonempty replacement check skips Bob's disabled reason. Real Rust normalization rejects parentheses and >40 characters; current tests incorrectly supply a nonempty replacement on the disabled candidate. Remove local grammar, preserve current-request freshness, and queue a submit until Bob supplies its authoritative replacement or refusal. (3) Mac integrated CI 40086037387 at 8400bd3 has 24 assertions failing: 21 new capture argv assertions across CapturePanelModelTests, CapturePullInChoiceModelTests, CaptureTemplateShelfModelTests still require the guard without positive capability; the other three are b7. Update the integrated tests/fixtures while preserving the positive-capability gate and meaningful negative submission assertions.

External triage via sase_new_task: corroborated existing bob-cli-b7 (+1) with both Mac runs; no new task and no causal active epic (scan receipt work belongs to closed bob-cli-at). A separate observation in bob-cli run 40085996699 is capture::related::draft_related_stays_under_the_debug_perf_gate, 1.712423541s versus 500ms, macOS only. Search all task types + weekly sweep found no owner. DECLINED immediate task creation: this single observation has neither a confirmed reproducible CI failure nor same-tree fail/pass flake evidence, so no supported task type yet; no capture-related runtime/test path changed in this epic. Do not misclassify it as a proved flake or add it to the repair scope without further evidence. Any new reproducible failure in verification must be triaged then.

Removed that unique exact line immediately, preserved every other byte, and verified absence. No product source files were changed by the audit. epic-symbols reports no entries; bob-cli has no symvision recipe. (2) relationLabelAuthoredReplacement removed; pending Return waits for a fresh bob capture-complete typed row (generation + exact authoredLabel); disabledReason consulted even on empty replacement; no Swift quoting. CaptureRelationPanelTests cover delayed/out-of-order/immediate Return/edit-after-Return/dismiss-reopen/repeated Return plus realistic refusals. Thin-client decision honored. (3) Mac model tests omit --require-pull-in-choice without positive pull_in.supported; guard-refusal obtains a capability-bearing no-offer preview then a write-only refusal via FAKE_BOB_CAPTURE_WRITE_STDOUT. Verification: just check green on bob-cli; just portable-check 1555/0 in bob-mac-capture; AppKit scratch typecheck on mac (rsync without .build/.git, bundle.sh --identity '-', just typecheck-tests) PASS BobMacCaptureTests.
